Title: Solution Purpose: Cyréna Platform Documentation
Content:
This solution is the public website and documentation for the Cyréna platform (the AI platform the user is interacting with). It serves as both a marketing landing page and comprehensive technical documentation.

Core Responsibilities:
- Public-facing marketing/landing pages with real content from cyrena.dev
- Technical documentation (getting started, guides, API reference)
- Platform feature documentation
- FAQ and support information
- Privacy policy page (required because we use web analytics tracking)

What Cyréna Actually Is:
- Offline-first desktop application (runs natively on your machine)
- NOT a web service, NOT a SaaS, NOT a server with endpoints
- Model-agnostic platform — NOT an AI model itself
- Users can connect Ollama (local/offline) or OpenAI (cloud) and switch between them in any chat at any time
- The platform orchestrates LLMs; the user brings the model
- No data leaves the machine when using local models
- Open source and extensible
- EXTENSIBLE — users build extensions (not plugins) to expand Cyréna beyond coding into custom integrations, workflows, and business-specific tooling

The Origin Story (featured on home page):
- The founder needed internal tooling for finances (invoicing, billing, suppliers) but is not an accountant
- Wanted something easy for a non-accountant to use, but exportable for an accountant into their professional software
- Did not have time to build from scratch, so used Base44 (an AI auto-app builder)
- After building, realised the tools could NOT be hosted on own infrastructure — still needed Base44. Vendor lock-in was real.
- That frustration became the inspiration for Cyréna: offline-first, own code, own infrastructure, no vendor lock-in
- This story is featured prominently on the home page as the "Built Out of Necessity" section

The Four Pillars (home page Core Capabilities):
1. Extensions — expand Cyréna with custom integrations, workflows, business-specific tooling
2. Coding — where it started. Deep support for .NET, PlatformIO, Arduino, and now Angular. More coming.
3. Offline-First & Model Agnostic — work offline with Ollama, online with OpenAI, switch anytime in any chat
4. Your Ideas — build anything from prototypes to production systems

Content Strategy:
- Home page: Hero with "Offline-First · Model-Agnostic · Desktop App" badge
- "Built Out of Necessity" origin story section (immediately after hero)
- "What Cyréna Actually Is" section: Desktop App, Offline-First, Model-Agnostic, No Server
- "Your AI, Your Choice" section: Ollama vs OpenAI side-by-side with switch visual
- The Four Pillars: Extensions, Coding, Offline-First & Model Agnostic, Your Ideas
- Multi-domain support: .NET, Arduino, PlatformIO, Angular
- "Cyréna Remembers" section: Two-part memory (Sticky Notes + API References) with .cyrena folder visual
- "What Cyréna Is NOT" reality check section
- Platform vision: from agent to platform
- Open source CTA section
- Privacy Policy page at /#/privacy — explains analytics data collection practices

Documentation Pages (under /#/docs):
- Getting Started — download, install, configure connections, start chatting
- .NET Development — prerequisites, supported project types, folder structure, workflow for cyrena.dotnet extension
- Core Concepts — key platform concepts
- API Reference — complete API documentation
- Guides — step-by-step tutorials
- FAQ — frequently asked questions

Privacy & Analytics:
- We use Cloudflare Web Analytics (privacy-first, no cookies, no persistent identifiers)
- Cloudflare does not set cookies, does not track across sessions/sites, anonymizes IP addresses
- We cannot identify individual visitors or extract personal data from analytics — data is fully aggregated and anonymous
- We do NOT collect personal identifiers, precise location, or cross-site tracking data
- Privacy policy explains that individual data access/deletion/portability requests cannot be fulfilled because Cloudflare does not provide tools to identify or extract data for a specific individual
- Raw IP addresses are not stored — only anonymized geographic summaries
- Data retention: maximum 26 months
- Visitors can opt out by blocking static.cloudflareinsights.com

Non-goals:
- Not a SaaS application with user accounts
- Not a real-time data dashboard
- Not a multi-tenant application
- Not an AI model provider
- Not a plugin system (we use "extensions", never "plugins")

Styling: Bootstrap CSS with custom dark theme accents
Routing: Hash-based location strategy (/#/routes)
Target: Angular v18+ with standalone components and signals
